title: Embedded game needs left click to receive input (instead of just any mouse click)
body:
### Tested versions

- Tested with v4.6.beta1.official [d743736f8]

### System information

Godot v4.6.beta1 - cpe:/o:nixos:nixos:26.05 #1-NixOS SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Mon Nov 24 09:37:52 UTC 2025 on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated AMD Radeon 840M Graphics (RADV GFX1152) - AMD Ryzen AI 5 340 w/ Radeon 840M (12 threads) - 14.91 GiB memory

### Issue description

When using the camera override in the embedded game window, after adjusting values outside of the embedded game window, one needs to left click into it, for it to receive keyboard input again. This means if one right-clicks into the embedded game window to control the camera, the camera can be controlled but it cannot be moved.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0f4aae62-23a1-4b1e-a959-3c284b1c88f4

(When I wiggle the mouse hard I'm unable to move the camera)

### Steps to reproduce

- Open the attached project
- Start in embedded mode
- Set to 3D selection mode and Camera override
- click on the editor outside of the embedded game
- right-click into the embedded game
You are now rotating the camera but cannot move the camera using the keyboard until left-clicking

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[embeddingexample2.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24172118/embeddingexample2.zip)
